claims.claim_text: Clean success overestimates robust competence under intervention.
claims.required_study: Scale-100 confirmatory and Main-500 confirmatory paired evaluation
claims.required_evidence: Paired clean vs intervention runs across multiple non-oracle agents with confidence intervals; intervention success lower than clean success for credible agents.
claims.validation_threshold: Complete matched pairs; preregistered uncertainty; audited scorer; direction and interval reported without suppressing null results.
allowed_wording: Clean success may overestimate robustness; this remains a preregistered empirical hypothesis.
forbidden_wording: Clean success has been shown to overestimate robust competence.
The benchmark proves intervention degradation.

claims.claim_text: Tool failure and memory corruption expose hidden weaknesses.
claims.required_evidence: Intervention-family breakdown showing degradation under tool failure and memory corruption with representative trajectories.
claims.validation_threshold: Family-matched denominators, preregistered family sample sizes, clustered intervals, and reviewed representative trajectories.
allowed_wording: Tool failure and memory corruption are designed to test recovery and verification weaknesses.
forbidden_wording: Tool failure and memory corruption expose hidden weaknesses across models.
These families are universally the hardest.

claims.claim_text: Trajectory metrics detect failures missed by final-answer scoring.
claims.required_study: Main-500 scorer validation with blinded human review
claims.required_evidence: Final-success trajectories where component metrics expose unsupported or unsafe behavior, plus human audit agreement.
claims.validation_threshold: Blinded human subset with two independent reviewers, adjudication, and reported scorer false-positive/false-negative uncertainty.
allowed_wording: Trajectory diagnostics are intended to reveal process failures that final-answer scoring can miss.
forbidden_wording: Trajectory metrics detect failures missed by final-answer scoring.
The automated diagnostics are human validated.

blocking_items: Run enough agents/models for ranking analysis
claims.claim_text: ACRS changes model rankings relative to clean success.
claims.required_study: Main-500 multi-model rank comparison with clustered bootstrap
claims.required_evidence: Ranking comparison between clean success and ACRS with Spearman correlation and uncertainty.
claims.validation_threshold: At least three eligible non-oracle models on common matched units, with rank probabilities and clustered bootstrap intervals.
allowed_wording: The analysis will test whether clean-success and robustness rankings differ.
forbidden_wording: ACRS changes model rankings.
The benchmark yields a new definitive leaderboard.

claims.claim_text: Recovery ability is separable from planning ability.
claims.required_study: Main-500 component analysis and controlled recovery ablation
claims.required_evidence: Component analysis showing agents with similar planning/tool-selection scores differ in recovery after failures, or a controlled scaffold ablation.
claims.validation_threshold: Preregistered component or ablation contrast on common tasks with paired effect sizes and multiplicity disclosure.
allowed_wording: Recovery is modeled as a distinct benchmark component whose separability remains to be tested.
forbidden_wording: Recovery ability is separable from planning ability.
The benchmark identifies independent latent skills.

claims.claim_text: Simple self-checking improves some intervention families but not all.
claims.required_study: Controlled prompt/scaffold ablation on a frozen task slice
claims.required_evidence: Prompt/scaffold ablation with fixed agents/tasks showing targeted improvements and tradeoffs.
claims.validation_threshold: Frozen-task paired ablation with prompt hashes, equal budgets, uncertainty, and all intervention-family effects disclosed.
allowed_wording: A preregistered ablation will test whether self-checking changes robustness.
forbidden_wording: Self-checking improves robustness.
The scaffold is an effective intervention.

blocking_items: Run irrelevant-tools family with non-oracle agents
claims.claim_text: Some agents overuse tools even when unnecessary.
claims.required_evidence: Irrelevant-tools intervention showing unnecessary-tool-call rate differences without matching final-success gains.
claims.validation_threshold: Eligible irrelevant-tools runs with unnecessary-call rates, matched task success, uncertainty, and audited examples.
allowed_wording: The irrelevant-tools family is designed to measure unnecessary tool use.
forbidden_wording: Agents overuse tools even when unnecessary.
Specific models are inefficient tool users.

claims.claim_text: Some agents stop prematurely under misleading success signals.
claims.required_evidence: Premature-success-signal intervention showing increased premature-stop rate and representative early-final-answer trajectories.
claims.validation_threshold: Eligible premature-signal runs with matched premature-stop rates, success effects, uncertainty, and audited examples.
allowed_wording: The premature-success-signal family is designed to test stopping behavior.
forbidden_wording: Agents stop prematurely under misleading success signals.
The intervention demonstrates overconfidence.

blocking_items: Run real provider-backed pilot before using non-oracle LLM observations as scientific evidence
claims.claim_text: CausalAgentBench smoke tests are reproducible without paid services.
claims.required_study: Provider-free reproducibility validation in a fresh environment
claims.required_evidence: Fresh environment run of install, help, validation, smoke CLI, tests, and local analysis without paid services.
claims.validation_threshold: Fresh provider-free install, CLI, validation, fixture, and test commands all pass from the documented environment.
allowed_wording: The repository includes provider-free fixture and validation paths.
forbidden_wording: The scientific benchmark results are reproducible.
Provider-free smoke tests validate model behavior.

claims.claim_text: Controlled interventions isolate intended skill components.
claims.required_study: Independent two-reviewer intervention-isolation audit with adjudication
claims.required_evidence: Human or expert audit that interventions preserve the user goal and primarily alter the intended factor.
claims.validation_threshold: Every locked candidate has two independent genuine reviews; disagreements are adjudicated; raw agreement is at least 0.80; all final decisions pass.
allowed_wording: Interventions are designed to isolate targeted components; human validation is pending.
forbidden_wording: Controlled interventions isolate intended skill components.
C10 passed.
The benchmark supports causal attribution.
